tests.name: text
tests.content: A compressor pumps a refrigerant gas through coils, raising its pressure and temperature. This hot gas releases heat to the surrounding room air as it condenses into a liquid. The liquid then expands in the interior coils, absorbing heat from the fridge's contents and turning back into a cold gas to repeat the cycle.

tests.name: reasoning
tests.content:
**17 × 19 = 323**

**Calculation:** I used the distributive property by rewriting 19 as (20 − 1):

17 × 19 = 17 × (20 − 1) = 340 − 17 = **323**

interpretation: RAM restore is demonstrated after successful GPU-only prefix resets by zero GPU hits, positive external hits/load bytes, a short recomputed tail, and identical generated token IDs.
Natural reuse also passes without reset: active_only removes idle GPU prefix metadata while preserving shared live-request references.
Parallel per-request metric windows overlap; use aggregate batch counters. Live requests can share GPU blocks during a batch.
First B4 shared-history shape took 4.936–5.321 seconds; three warmed repetitions took 1.017–1.271 seconds.
Sixty-four independent 512-token histories exceed the RAM budget through fixed-size recurrent checkpoints; newest history restores from RAM while old 20K history recomputes correctly.
Pinned-memory transfer microbenchmark measures bare contiguous copies; end-to-end restores additionally reconstruct KVarN side buffers and schedule model work.
